claims.episode_span: not directed at any specific country or target
claims.source_title: Chinese naval carrier group enters western Pacific
claims.supporting_quote: “The drill is part of the annual routine training plan aimed at testing and improving the troops’ combat readiness and enhancing their ability to fulfill missions,” the PLA Navy said, adding that the exercises” are not directed at any specific country or target.”

claims.supporting_quote: Meanwhile, 15 Chinese military aircraft, 10 naval ships and seven official ships were detected around Taiwan between 6pm yesterday and 6am today, the ministry said in its daily report.

claims.claim: The Batam blackout began around 6.30am Monday and lasted about 16 hours, with estimated losses of about 233.5 billion rupiah.
claims.episode_span: estimated losses of about 233.5 billion rupiah
claims.source_title: Batam blackout may have been caused by lightning, bat interference: Minister
claims.supporting_quote: The blackout is estimated to have caused economic losses of around 233.5 billion rupiah (US$13 million), according to the Batam branch of the Indonesian Economists Association (ISEI).

claims.claim: Bahlil Lahadalia said lightning and a possible bat were suspected causes of the Batam-area blackout.
claims.episode_span: lightning and a possible bat in the grid were among the suspected causes
claims.source_title: Batam blackout may have been caused by lightning, bat interference: Minister
claims.supporting_quote: An animal, possibly a bat, was also suspected of contributing to the disruption, Bahlil said, without providing further details on how it may have affected the network.

claims.claim: PLN replaced chief executive Darmawan Prasodjo with Suroso Isnandar, and it was unclear whether the change related to the Batam blackout.
claims.episode_span: Darmawan Prasodjo had been replaced by former risk-management director Suroso Isnandar
claims.source_title: Batam blackout may have been caused by lightning, bat interference: Minister
claims.supporting_quote: Separately, PLN also replaced its chief executive Darmawan Prasodjo, the company’s commissioner said on Thursday. It was unclear whether the change was related to the Batam blackout.

claims.claim: H5 bird flu was detected in samples from a southern elephant seal and a kelp gull on Macquarie Island.
claims.episode_span: samples from a southern elephant seal and a kelp gull
claims.source_title: Bird flu detected in seal, bird samples taken from remote southern island
claims.supporting_quote: Samples collected from a southern elephant seal and a kelp gull were returned with island personnel and subsequently tested, returning a positive result for H5 bird flu.

claims.claim: Guy Barnett said the seal detection was the first recorded detection in a marine mammal in Tasmania.
claims.episode_span: the first recorded detection in a marine mammal in Tasmania
claims.source_title: Bird flu detected in seal, bird samples taken from remote southern island
claims.supporting_quote: Tasmania's Minister for Environment and Climate Change Guy Barnett said in a statement on Thursday it was the "first recorded detection in a marine mammal in Tasmania".

claims.claim: More than 13,000 elephant seal pups are believed to have died from bird flu on Heard Island over summer.
claims.episode_span: more than 13,000 pups are believed to have died from bird flu
claims.source_title: Bird flu detected in seal, bird samples taken from remote southern island
claims.supporting_quote: It is feared up to 90 per cent of baby elephant seals could perish, as happened on Heard Island over summer, where more than 13,000 pups are believed to have died from bird flu.

claims.supporting_quote: Micron employs about 15,000 people in Taiwan, one of its most important manufacturing hubs, and has said it invested more than NT$1.6 trillion (S$63.36 billion) on the island.

claims.supporting_quote: “We have already sold out all the capacity for 2027 that this factory will build and we expect high-bandwidth memory to grow faster than the rest of the DRAM industry all the way through 2028,” he said.
